max_iterations.comparison: on syndrome fail, launch another iteration only when completed_next < max_iterations

decide_semantics.completed_next: completed_iterations + 1 for the iteration whose syndrome decision just completed
decide_semantics.counter_update: completed_iterations_after_decide = completed_next for every DECIDE outcome
decide_semantics.else: launch next iteration after recording completed_next

max_iterations.iteration_counter: 4-bit completed-iteration counter; starts at 0 for a block and increments once per completed syndrome decision
max_iterations.non_speculative_policy: no next-iteration ACC issue before the current syndrome decision
max_iterations.out_of_range_behavior: unrepresentable at 4 bits; wider integration values must be rejected before programming the core
max_iterations.syndrome_independence: max_iterations bounds retry count; it does not force or bypass syndrome early termination

reset.deassertion: synchronous; enters IDLE on a clock boundary
reset.large_memory_clear: not required; epoch/valid metadata must prevent stale payload visibility
reset.minimum_assertion: one rising edge after clock stability
reset.synchronization: synchronous to the single core clock; board-level async reset synchronization is outside the decoder core

start_done_abort_error.abort: synchronous abort stops new issue on the next cycle, invalidates live epochs/valids, suppresses output, and returns to IDLE with aborted status set
start_done_abort_error.done_behavior: done_o is a sticky level in DONE until the next accepted start, explicit status clear, abort clear, or reset; a one-cycle pulse may be derived but is not the architectural state
start_done_abort_error.early_termination: only DECIDE may terminate early after syndrome_done and syndrome_zero are both true
start_done_abort_error.fatal_error: stop new issue, invalidate partial output, latch error cause, and remain in ERROR until reset or explicit clear from IDLE-safe integration
start_done_abort_error.start: accepted only in IDLE with legal configuration; illegal configuration enters ERROR before memory mutation

syndrome.clear_semantics: parallel clear or epoch invalidation are permitted physical mechanisms beneath the same logical-zero rule
syndrome.collision_behavior: if multiple consumed work items target the same row in one cycle, XOR-reduce by row before the single architectural accumulator update or use an equivalent collision-safe multiwrite implementation
syndrome.logical_zero_semantics: at each iteration start all architectural syndrome accumulators behave as zero before any work item is consumed; stale prior-iteration state is inaccessible; establishing logical zero consumes no decoder cycle
syndrome.push_pop_order: new finalized columns with final_valid_cycle <= current cycle are admitted before up to S work items are consumed; enqueue and consume in the same cycle are legal
syndrome.queue_entry: base column, canonical hard vector from final APP, active-lane mask, iteration epoch, and work iterator
syndrome.queue_overflow: fatal architectural error; no drop or overwrite
syndrome.syndrome_done: all active columns finalized exactly once, all active QC edges consumed exactly once, queue empty, internal iterator empty, and all row accumulators complete
syndrome.syndrome_zero: all active syndrome bits in every active row are zero
